# ScribeCat 0.27.1

- Rename notes and folders directly in their title field in the file viewer.
- Arrange task categories by dragging, and arrange or move task section headings with their Markdown content. Section headings appear above their tasks; tasks can be moved between headings.
- Create sections on a category page, with fewer controls in the task sidebar and a category picker styled like the rest of the app.
- Return from a diary entry to the calendar with Escape. Opening a note from the sidebar brings it to the front.
- Hide configured diary and task folders in Move to, sidebar search, and vault search when their hide settings are enabled.
- Keep folder expansion in the sidebar in step with folder navigation in the file viewer.
- Place table insertion controls on the table edges.
